rv.q: All four of these capable performers are ensemble players and keen listeners, expertly wearing their characters on their sleeves, and providing engagingly organic performances.
While Machine Learning is not nearly as fascinating as that unsettling little play, it does give me a clear sense of the stories that make Little Engine chug.

cn.t: Vozella's darkly comedic AI-themed play creates an inviting atmosphere but struggles with execution, earning mixed reviews for its premise about couples training robotic companions in close quarters.
